text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Yukino Bijin! With a 
fierce, breathtaking run, she brings glory 
back home to her hometown!

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: Waaah...! That's crazy cool, Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: ...Man, that's so cool...

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: —Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...W-What the?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I know every single thing 
about your situation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though... Even though running in the 
JRA has brought a lot of hardships—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Chasin' your dreams is super freakin' 
fun! That's the one thing I really wanted 
ya to know!

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it. I'm an Umamusume too, so I 
can tell just by watchin' 'em run.

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
She gets polished up more and more, 
shining brighter all the time—that 
Yukino-chan.

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
I think I might run just a bit more after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
To tell ya the truth, I thought I had no 
talent and wanted to run away. But... I 
can give up whenever, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to be the second "Star of Morioka"! 
...Heh, am I being too naive?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't gonna be easy"? Like hell! 
Umamusume from Morioka are made of pure 
grit—we can totally do this!

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yukinko, and Trainer too, so this is 
where you were!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya?

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
We're having a victory party right now! It 
can't start without the star of the show, 
can it?!
choice_data_list: Is it really okay for me to join in too?

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
No way, aren't you the star of the show 
here! Tell us all about what life's like 
for you in the city, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
I've already booked the best inn around! 
By the way, Trainer, do you like alcohol?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huuuh!?

text_block_list.name: Villager B
text_block_list.text:
"—An' even when she was just a tiny 
mochi-lookin' thing, Yukino had some 
serious guts! She'd always wander into 
people's houses!"

text_block_list.name: Villager C
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your glass is empty! My family 
runs a liquor shop, so let me bring out 
the best stuff we've got!

text_block_list.name: Villager D
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, city folk really are somethin' 
else. Say, ya got yerself a sweetheart?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, guys! Look, you're troubling 
Trainer-san, aren't you!?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that! They're all good folks, 
really... They just turn into absolute 
messes when they drink.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you're so kind...

text_block_list.name: Villager E
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Yukino is our pride and joy, yes 
she is! Please keep takin' good care of 
her, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right! Yukino is the 'Star 
of Morioka'~!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Geez. You drunkard~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes! They're all the people I love 
so much!

text_block_list.name: Villager F
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... Trainer-san! Can ya dance, by any 
chance!?

text_block_list.name: Villager F
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, get over here! I'll teach ya a 
thing or two~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! H-Hey~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"What happened to having a victory party?! 
Don't go dragging Trainer into your party 
tricks!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by warm laughter, the night in 
Morioka deepened—
